info.title: Decision-Trace Company Brain API
info.description: Knowledge graph backend connecting decisions, people, systems, and evidence via FalkorDB.

get.description: Retrieve decisions filtered by system, person, and/or health status.

parameters.name: system

schema.description: Filter decisions by system name (e.g. Redis, Kafka)
schema.title: System

parameters.description: Filter decisions by system name (e.g. Redis, Kafka)

get.description:
Full decision page: health, deciders, sources, lineage chains, system timeline, impact,
the deduplicated subgraph, and the Cypher that produced it. Accepts a DEC code (DEC-11),
a decision id, or an exact title.

post.description: Answer a natural language question grounded strictly in a retrieved FalkorDB subgraph.

get.description: Retrieve nodes and edges with optional type filters and node limits for visualization.

parameters.name: types

schema.description: Filter by node labels (e.g. Decision, Person, System, Ticket, Meeting)
schema.title: Types

parameters.description: Filter by node labels (e.g. Decision, Person, System, Ticket, Meeting)

get.description:
Every system with its owner, orphaned flag, and decision/ticket counts.
Orphaned systems first, then by number of decisions.
A system's owner, orphaned flag, decisions (oldest first), people and teams.
Everyone, with teams, systems owned, decision count and whether they have left.
A person's decisions (oldest first), systems owned, teams led or joined, and activity.

post.description: Reset the knowledge graph, deleting all nodes, edges, vectors, and Cognee metadata.

get.description: Health check endpoint validating service and FalkorDB connectivity.

question.title: Question
question.description: Natural language question to query the Company Brain (max 500 characters)

primary_decision_id.title: Primary Decision Id
primary_decision_id.description: ID of the decision the answer is mainly about (null when nothing was found)

AskResponse.title: AskResponse
AskResponse.description: Grounded question answer with citations and evidence subgraph.

id.title: Id
id.description: Node ID or unique key (e.g. TICK-101)

Citation.title: Citation
Citation.description: Evidence citation linking an answer to a graph node.

CypherTraceOut.title: CypherTraceOut
CypherTraceOut.description: The exact Cypher statements that produced a response, with timings.

decider_departed.title: Decider Departed
decider_departed.description: True if any decider has left the company

rationale.title: Rationale
rationale.description: Trade-offs, constraints, and why it was made

contradicts.title: Contradicts
contradicts.description: Decisions contradicted by or contradicting this decision

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.description: Every decision on the same system(s), oldest first, including this one

DecisionDetail.title: DecisionDetail
DecisionDetail.description: Detailed decision view including graph connections and health audit.

DecisionRef.title: DecisionRef
DecisionRef.description: Compact decision reference used in lineage, timelines and entity pages.

decision_code.title: Decision Code
decision_code.description: Stable human-readable code, e.g. DEC-07 (by decision date, then title)

system.title: System
system.description: System name(s) this decision governs, comma-joined

decided_by.title: Decided By
decided_by.description: Person(s) who made the decision, comma-joined

decider_departed.title: Decider Departed
decider_departed.description: True if any decider has left the company

DecisionSummary.title: DecisionSummary
DecisionSummary.description: Concise decision summary for list views.

label.title: Label
label.description: Primary node label (e.g. Decision, Person, System)

GraphNode.title: GraphNode
GraphNode.description: Graph node in a serialized graph representation.

omitted_count.title: Omitted Count
omitted_count.description: Number of evidence nodes omitted due to the ~15 node cap

GraphPath.title: GraphPath
GraphPath.description: Connected subgraph traversed to formulate an answer.

GraphResponse.title: GraphResponse
GraphResponse.description: Graph query result with type filtering.

Impact.title: Impact
Impact.description: Teams, projects and people within two hops of the decision's systems.

supersedes.title: Supersedes
supersedes.description: Older decisions this one replaces, transitively

superseded_by.title: Superseded By
superseded_by.description: Newer decisions that replace this one, transitively

contradicted_by.title: Contradicted By
contradicted_by.description: Decisions that contradict this one (incoming edge)

Lineage.title: Lineage
Lineage.description: Full supersedes chains (both directions) and contradiction links of a decision.

LineageItem.title: LineageItem
LineageItem.description: A decision in a supersedes chain; depth 1 is the direct neighbour.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: owner, decider, and/or tickets (raised or assigned)

PersonInvolvement.title: PersonInvolvement
PersonInvolvement.description: A person connected to a system, and how.

PersonRef.title: PersonRef
PersonRef.description: A person, with whether they have left the company.

quote.title: Quote
quote.description: Verbatim evidence quote. Quotes are stored per decision, so this is set only when the decision has a single source; otherwise see DecisionDetail.evidence_quote.

SourceDetail.title: SourceDetail
SourceDetail.description: An evidence source of a decision.

SubgraphOut.title: SubgraphOut
SubgraphOut.description: Deduplicated nodes and edges touched by a detail response. Node ids are 'Label:key'.

orphaned.title: Orphaned
orphaned.description: True if the owner has left the company

orphaned.title: Orphaned
orphaned.description: True if the owner has left the company

SystemSummary.title: SystemSummary
SystemSummary.description: A system with its owner and whether it is orphaned (owner has left).
